quotes.text: Everybody may be clapping for me while God sees something He does not approve. Human congratulations do not answer the questions His Word asks.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 1: Pleasing God

quotes.text: God did not call me so that I'll preach for you to like me.
quotes.speaker: Adelaide Heward-Mills
quotes.title: The Woman Who Pleases God — Part Two

quotes.text: When you please men you often do not please God. Pleasing men is often the furthest thing from pleasing God!
quotes.speaker: Dag Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Faith Secrets · Chapter 61: Faith Is Your Only Way to Please God

quotes.text: I obey because I want to obey God's Word, not because human approval has replaced His. The outward act may look the same, but the motive matters.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 3: Alternatives to Pleasing God

quotes.text: Seek the kingdom of God before you seek your personal kingdom of wealth, comfort and security.
quotes.speaker: Dag Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Spiritual Dangers · Chapter 2: Why the Kingdom of God Must Be Your First Passion

quotes.text: Being close to the pastor is not a substitute for having a heart that pleases God.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 8: Those Who Do Not Please God

quotes.text: It was just you, your God and your love for him.
quotes.speaker: Adelaide Heward-Mills
quotes.title: The Woman Who Pleases God — Part Two

quotes.text: Why do we want Him to supply an idol? Why do we insist that a particular thing must be added before we can be satisfied with Him?
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 8: Those Who Do Not Please God

quotes.text: You do not require an audience before you take His Word seriously. The One you want to please is already there.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 2: The Faith of the God Pleaser

quotes.text: Don't think about me. Think about him.
quotes.speaker: Dag Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Please and Impress God · Chicago, 2014

quotes.text: Even a pastor's approval can be different from God's approval.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 3: Alternatives to Pleasing God

quotes.text: We are busy about the work of the Lord but we are not involved with the Lord of the work
quotes.speaker: Adelaide Heward-Mills
quotes.title: The Woman Who Pleases God — Part Two

quotes.text: Sometimes obedience means risking the displeasure of people. Their approval cannot become more important than His.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 2: The Faith of the God Pleaser

quotes.text: We can want what He gives while being unwilling to choose Him above the gift.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 8: Those Who Do Not Please God

quotes.text: To please God, you need to obey His will and do His will.
quotes.speaker: Dag Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Ready at 20 · Chapter 11: Ready@20 to Please God

quotes.text: Human reactions pass. People's anger, opinions, and comments do not last forever.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 3: Alternatives to Pleasing God

quotes.text: When your ways please God, he fights your battles for you.
quotes.speaker: Adelaide Heward-Mills
quotes.title: The Woman Who Pleases God — Part Two

quotes.text: Would Abraham choose the gift or the Giver? Had he followed God for God Himself, or only for the thing he expected to receive?
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 4: God Sees Not As Man Sees

quotes.text: It is possible to be crying and yet to have a soul that is satisfied in God.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 1: Pleasing God

quotes.text: The believer's constant ambition should be to please God. A career, a country to live in, a marriage, or a ministry cannot take His place as the ultimate aim.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Heward-Mills
quotes.title: Pleasing God · Chapter 3: Alternatives to Pleasing God
